purpose: Auditable language atlas source snapshots for the admin importer

primary_sources.notes: Current public response. ROLVCode is numeric in JSON and must be zero-padded to five-character text in the normalized registry. No coordinate or audio fields are exposed by this query.
Join to a variety by zero-padded ROLVCode and LanguageTag. Preserve alternate names as source records.
ChangeType values are A, M, U, and R per the official ROLV documentation. Keep history independent of the current code list.

primary_sources.service_scope: MapServer Feature Layer 1, Language Varieties; service reports capabilities Map,Query,Data, maxRecordCount 2000, singleFusedMapCache false, supports GeoJSON, and count/object ID queries report the complete 1476-feature layer.
primary_sources.notes: 989 Dialect records and 487 ISO_Lang records; 1419 Verified and 57 Unverified; 1395 records have Point geometry and 81 have null geometry. grn_num is a GRN language number. For Dialect rows it can be joined to a current ROLV only by exact zero-padded code; ISO_Lang rows join by explicit ISO 639-3 and are language-area placements. Preserve geometry coordinates separately from rounded attribute longitude/latitude.

Derived index with stable source_id grnmapapp:LanguageResources_v6/MapServer/1:objectid:<objectid>, explicit match_basis, exact rolv_code_exact only for Dialect rows, ISO language-area matching for ISO_Lang rows, and both source_coordinates and attribute_coordinates.

local_registry_sources.notes: Preserved original local response so six removed records and all historical source values remain auditable.

All workbook tables are retained as headers plus row arrays. raw_glottolog_5_3 contains 27177 data rows: 4853 family, 8618 language, and 13706 dialect records. Glottocode id and parent_id values are the stable parent links; family rows are retained but excluded from mapped-language counts.

rolv_delta.notes: Use the separate old and current full snapshots plus this delta; do not silently replace the old registry.

provenance_and_terms.rolv_profile_pattern: https://globalrecordings.net/en/language/vvvvv (the public page may canonicalize a leading-zero code in the URL; retain the five-digit code in data)
provenance_and_terms.rolv_terms: The public ROLV page documents the registry and downloads but supplies no separate API license text. Confirm permission and attribution before republishing registry content.
provenance_and_terms.mapapp_terms: The ArcGIS service metadata supplies no explicit license or copyright text in the retrieved response. Confirm permission and attribution before republishing coordinates.
provenance_and_terms.audio_terms: Individual GRN program pages state that recordings may be freely copied for personal or local ministry use when unmodified and not sold or bundled with sold products; other redistribution requires GRN permission. Do not copy media into the atlas; link to GRN pages and preserve this limitation.

normalization_policy.rolv_code: String, exactly five ASCII digits, left-zero-padded from API numeric values.
normalization_policy.iso_parent: LanguageCode / iso639_3 is the explicit ISO 639-3 parent crosswalk for each ROLV variety.
normalization_policy.dialect_identity: Do not infer dialect-specific Scripture or media from an ISO parent. A parent ISO or country match is not evidence for the ROLV variety.
normalization_policy.coordinates: Use MapApp geometry only when present and label it as source geometry; retain rounded attribute coordinates separately. No MapApp point is a complete substitute for absent ROLV coordinates.
normalization_policy.source_ids: MapApp source_id uses layer path plus immutable objectid. ROLV source records use the exact tuple LanguageCode|ROLVCode|LanguageTag. Glottolog uses its stable glottocode id and parent_id.
